_about: PlannerMC design tokens. MacroCap source colors are observed values from replica/brand-reference.md unless noted as proposed. Contrast check: python contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json.

color_notes.border: Observed border was white at 10% opacity; #2F2F2F is its approximate sRGB value over #0A0A0A. Decorative divider only.
color_notes.border-input: Adjusted from the observed 15% white input border to #707070 to meet the 3:1 UI contrast minimum on the dark surfaces.
color_notes.brand-cyan: Approximate dominant color sampled from the public MacroCap Labs logo asset.
color_notes.brand-green: Approximate dominant color sampled from the public MacroCap Labs logo asset.
color_notes.warning: Proposed semantic warning color. No warning color was visible on the public sign-in reference; this value is selected for contrast and is not represented as a measured brand color.

font.sans: Geist Variable, Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
